_comment: The gas station's attendant: a figure with a skin on bones (attendant.kn5, tools/Props/ActorBuilder from tools/StationScene/build_station.py) and his talk, the animation that moves his bones round and round (talk.ksanim, seconds a turn). The station says where he stands (station.json, attendant). He has no place in a garage.
